RagShortTexts: What are the performance characteristics of the Vardar Hotblood Horse?

Variants.Content: The Wardar Warhorse is considered the finest warhorse in Calradia. It has a strong physique, amazing speed, and terrifying endurance. It can almost predict the rider's intentions on the battlefield. This kind of horse is extremely rare, and it is said that there are only a few in the entire continent. Only the most powerful rulers or the most legendary warriors are qualified to ride it.

The Vardar hot-blooded horse is considered the best horse in the world by our imperial people. Its speed, strength and endurance have reached a perfect balance, especially long-distance running and complex terrain, it can easily handle it. The empire once had several horses, but I don’t know whose hands they are now.

The Vardar hot-blooded horses are most praised for their spirituality and endurance. It can run all day long without getting tired, and its steering is as nimble as a falcon. If I were asked to choose a war horse to entrust my life to, I would choose it without hesitation. Of course, this kind of horse cannot be bought with money.

Vadar hot-blooded horse? That's the real king of horses. I saw it once from a distance. Its momentum was completely different from that of an ordinary war horse. It ran as if its four hooves were not touching the ground. I heard that in the entire empire, only the top big shots can have it.

The Vadar hot-blooded horse is the most precious legend in the desert. We Aserai know horses best, and the Vadar hot-blooded horse has almost no shortcomings - it has both powerful impact and the endurance of a desert horse. This is a true all-round war horse and the dream of all Emirs.

In Aserai, a Vardar hot-blooded horse can be exchanged for a rich oasis. Its value lies in the fact that it can exert its full strength on sand, mountains, and grasslands regardless of terrain. A horse like this is enough to greatly improve a family's status in the tribe.

I have been selling horses all my life, and I have only heard of Vadar hot-blooded horses, but never seen the real ones. It is said that its price is an astronomical figure, and there is no market for it. If anyone can get one, the breeding fee alone can ensure food and clothing for three generations.

The Vardar Hotblood is the ultimate dream for any rider. It runs like a gust of wind, and its endurance is surprisingly good. No one can catch up with it on the grassland. What's more important is that it understands human nature and can even actively avoid danger in critical moments.

We Khuzait value a horse’s endurance and speed above all else, and the Vadar Hotblooded Horse achieves both of these to the extreme. Not only can it travel thousands of miles in a day, but it can also sprint over short distances unmatched by horses. Legend has it that the Great Khan of Monchug had one in his stable, but I have never seen one.

Vardar's hot-blooded horse is the dream mount of all knights. It possesses unparalleled impact and amazing endurance, and is the most dazzling presence in both the competition field and the battlefield. Anyone who can ride such a horse is definitely a strong person.

King Detel has always wanted to add a Vardar hot-blooded horse to his stable, but has not been able to do so so far. The precious thing about this kind of horse is that it can maintain top combat effectiveness on any terrain, unlike some horses that only dominate on the plains.

The most remarkable thing about the Vadar hot-blooded horse is that it can run very fast even in the hills and forests of our Battania. It seems to naturally know how to navigate complex terrain and will not easily trip over branches.

The Vardar Hotblood is the only mount that makes my heart flutter. It can not only charge on the plains, but also flexibly travel through the mountains. If I could get one, I would even trade it for the best hunting ground in the territory.

The Vadar hot-blooded horse is much faster than our northern pony horses, but it is not as cold as the southern horses. Its hooves can adapt to ice and snow, and it can still run stably in the wind and snow of the North. This is one of the very few foreign horses that we Sturgians can appreciate.
Grand Duke Langward once said that if anyone can offer a Vardar hot-blooded horse, he will reward him heavily. The rarity of this horse made it a more reliable hard currency than gold and land.

Vadar hot-blooded horses are one of the few horses that can adapt to life at sea. He can stand on the rocking deck of a long ship without panicking like other horses. Of course, we Nords still prefer to fight on foot, but if you must mount a horse, it's the best choice.

The Wardar Warhorse is the pinnacle of Calradia's warhorses. It combines speed, strength, endurance and agility, with almost no shortcomings. Its rarity makes it a top strategic resource and status symbol, and its value far exceeds that of a simple means of transportation.

There are two ways to obtain the Vadar hot-blooded horse. One is that in some large-scale competitive meetings, the organizers may take out this kind of horse as the final grand prize - of course, this opportunity is once in a blue moon. The other is that after those fierce battles that decided the fate of the kingdom, it could occasionally be found among the spoils when cleaning the battlefield. But no matter what, it only belongs to those strong people who have both strength and luck.
